fields.label: Enable Notifications
fields.description: Untick to stop every driver notification.

fields.label: 1. New trip assigned
fields.description: A trip is assigned to the driver, or moved to them from someone else.

fields.label: 2. Trip updated / re-optimised
fields.description: Stops are added to their trip, or the stop order changes.

fields.label: 3. Order rescheduled by ops
fields.description: The office moves a delivery date. Silent when the driver reschedules it.

fields.label: 4. Order cancelled / pulled from trip
fields.description: An order is cancelled, pulled off the trip, or the whole trip is taken away.

fields.label: 5. Collection limit warning (≥80%)
fields.description: Cash collected passes 80% of the daily limit. Once a day.

fields.label: 6. Collection limit reached (100%)
fields.description: The limit is hit and no more COD can be accepted. Once a day.

fields.label: 7. Customer chat message
fields.description: Someone other than the driver writes on one of their orders.

fields.label: 8. COD-Online payment confirmed
fields.description: An online COD payment clears, which unblocks the delivery OTP.

fields.label: 9. Cash handover accepted by WM
fields.description: The warehouse manager accepts the cash and the daily limit resets.
